notes: Cross-verse head split on `שָׁכַם` Hiphil. This verse headed *arose early* on the adverb *early* (t009) while JDG.6.38 heads the identical construction *rose up early* on the lexical verb *rose*. Both verses' notes state that the head stays on the lexical verb, and every other verb-plus-particle/adverb unit in the chapter does so, so this verse's head is corrected to *arose* (t008). Nothing else in the verse changes.
